provenance: New source translation; E4630-E4639 and E4720-E4729 reviewed.
context: Anselm betrays the party, despairing over centuries of imprisonment; Beatrix rejects his reasoning. Later Cyrus replaces Anselm for the fiends' summoning ritual.
decisions: Adoptive relationship explicit; father address naturalized to Father. Anselm's fatalism and Beatrix's anger preserved. Unknown voices use neutral wording. Cross-row sentences retain breaks.

translations.en: The figures that appeared
were @7rGate Keeper@0r and @7rKey Master@0r, whom you thought you had defeated.
translations.context: Independent event meaning reviews: events_middle reviewed first range, events_last reviewed middle range; parent verified source/context before accepting. Preserve source controls and per-row boundaries.

translations.en: We told you we would return, didn't we?
Father, why...?
@7rBeatrix@0r. My daughter.
Forgive me... I'm truly sorry...
But you must understand... the bitterness in my heart!
My master shut me in here so that this town could survive.
He made me a prisoner of this town!
If it had helped the town, I could have borne it.
But in the end, all my master accomplished
was to bring a slow death upon it.
The gate will open, and this town will vanish anyway!
If it was to vanish regardless,
I wanted at least to destroy it with my own hands.
For keeping me imprisoned here for nothing,
I wanted to be the one who decided to destroy this town!
Go now, @7rGate Keeper@0r and @7rKey Master@0r!
I will not let them follow!
At that instant, the door opened,
and countless monsters stood in your way, as if protecting @7rAnselm@0r.
Hurry! @7rBeatrix@0r, seal it, quickly!
Together with @7rCarmine@0r, you pushed against the open door
and forced it shut again. But even a moment's lapse
would let the pressure from the other side blow you away.
Something's wrong!
This bronze ornament isn't reacting at all!
Does that mean the magic circle's broken?!
Something... Something is missing!
Stop... this futile effort.
This town and the world... were destined for destruction.
We merely delayed it...
That's not true!
Nothing we've done has been in vain!
You cannot defy fate.
I have undone every seal on this town.
You can choose to leave the town and live as you please.
Only until the world ends, of course,
but even so, you could taste freedom.
Father...
You've been thinking about that...?
By adopting you, I condemned you to a life without freedom.
I'm sorry...
How... How could you...
You destroyed the seal because of that selfish assumption?!
I wanted to protect this town with all my heart!!
We have to fall back! We can't seal it while we're here.
We need to find out how to use the bronze ornament!
Back to town, now!!
Indeed, retreat was your only option for now.
You decided to follow @7rCarmine's@0r advice.
We'll construct a circle to summon @7rGate Keeper@0r and @7rKey Master@0r.
So I get worked to the bone in the end too...
I'm sorry. We need three mages to construct the circle.
It's fine. At least this means I'm not a coward anymore.
No one's calling you a coward!
After that brief exchange, the three began chanting for the circle.
Demons swarmed toward you as if to interfere.
At the center of the circle @7rBeatrix@0r and the others had constructed,
the air wavered. Shadows gradually began taking shape.
I summon thee!
@7rGate Keeper@0r! @7rKey Master@0r!
Heed my command and appear!!
@7rBeatrix's@0r chanting cry rang out clearly.
As her words completed the circle, two figures appeared,
@7rGate Keeper@0r and @7rKey Master@0r, their bloodshot eyes fixed on you.
You little girls... Have you finally gone mad?!
You summon me because you wish to die today?!
Hee hee hee. Stupid creatures.
What do you hope to accomplish?
You've done nothing but come here to die!
Heh heh heh. Do you think summoning us means you can win?
But... hee hee hee... how convenient.
We've been wanting to test our strength...
You seem stronger, but did you think we hadn't changed?
No matter. First, we'll settle the score from last time!
Hee hee hee hee... Hee hee hee hee.
Your corpses shall be the offerings at tonight's feast!
The moment you defeated @7rGate Keeper@0r and @7rKey Master@0r,
rainbow light began spilling from the bronze statue in @7rBeatrix's@0r hands
